title: tripteris nyikensis
intro: Tripteris nyikensis, commonly known as "Buchu of the mountains", is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of southern Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, supporting the treatment of urinary tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tripteris nyikensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
